platform: Linux WSL x86_64; NOT Android or vivo
method: One ps snapshot per active inference process: ps -eo pid,stat,pcpu,rss,wchan:25,comm
metric: Linux RSS KiB; not PSS, not measured peak, not total system/model footprint
limitations: Different input file counts and Python waveform arrays
Weights staged on tmpfs; file cache contributes to system RAM separately
